summary: An on-call aide takes another job because the number of paid visits changes from week to week.
realLife: Adams told senators that his home-care hours varied with calls and that he also worked in retail to support himself and his brother.
gates: Both jobs and variable care hours are on the worker’s record.
inGame: needs: two job schedules and a record of variable hours.

turns.pulledBy: Steadier care hours bring enough income and the worker decides to leave.

turns.what: The worker turns down a care call.
turns.pulledBy: The retail shift overlaps the proposed visit.
turns.writesBack: The coordinator has an open call to fill.
